about_blocks.text: About Into Action Recovery Bear Creek

Into Action Recovery Bear Creek is a men-only residential recovery house at 13222 87B Avenue in the Newton area of Surrey, British Columbia. It is one of three Surrey houses run by Into Action Recovery Society, a program that has worked with men in the Lower Mainland since 2012.
about_blocks.html: Into Action Recovery Bear Creek is a men-only residential recovery house at 13222 87B Avenue in the Newton area of Surrey, British Columbia. It is one of three Surrey houses run by Into Action Recovery Society, a program that has worked with men in the Lower Mainland since 2012.

about_blocks.text: The house looks like the rest of the street: a two-storey stucco home with a big arched front window and a garage. Inside, men share a living room with a gas fireplace, a formal dining room with one long wooden table, a separate sitting room and an open kitchen with an island. Bedrooms are single or shared. Into Action's website shows these rooms on its Surrey page, and recovery.com lists air-conditioned rooms, a fitness area and outdoor space.

about_blocks.text: Bear Creek runs Into Action's First Stage program. The centre describes it as a 60-day minimum, with extensions when a man needs more time, and its other pages mention 30, 60 and 90-day stays. Days are scheduled. There are educational groups, process groups, one-to-one counselling, 12-step meetings in the community and aftercare planning before discharge. The program draws on CBT, DBT, SMART Recovery and the Twelve Steps, and attendance at groups is mandatory.

about_blocks.text: This is a supportive recovery residence, not a hospital. Into Action says it has no doctors or nurses on site and does not treat mental health conditions directly. Residents see a virtual care provider the centre works with, or their own doctor, for medication and medical needs. Men who need detox finish it somewhere else before they arrive.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Into Action Recovery Bear Creek

faqs.question: How much does Into Action Recovery Bear Creek cost?

answer_blocks.text: recovery.com estimates $10,000 to $30,000 CAD for a stay at Bear Creek, depending on how long you stay. Into Action is private pay and does not publish a fee table, so admissions gives the full cost on your first call. The centre says it can help families look at payment options.

Into Action is private pay and does not publish a fee table, so admissions gives the full cost on your first call. The centre says it can help families look at payment options.

faqs.question: How long is the program at Bear Creek?

answer_blocks.text: Into Action calls its First Stage residential program a 60-day minimum, with extensions when they help. Its other pages also mention 30, 60 and 90-day stays, and recovery.com lists 30 to 90 days. The length is set at intake and reviewed while you are there.

faqs.question: Is Bear Creek a medical treatment centre?

answer_blocks.text: No. Bear Creek is a supportive recovery residence. Into Action says it has no doctors or nurses on site and works with virtual healthcare providers, or your own doctor, for medication and medical care.

faqs.question: Does Into Action Recovery Bear Creek offer detox?

answer_blocks.text: No. Men who need medically supervised withdrawal have to finish detox at another facility before admission. Into Action's admissions team says it can help line up detox so there is no gap before you move in.

faqs.question: Where is Bear Creek and how do I get there?

answer_blocks.text: The house is at 13222 87B Avenue in Newton, Surrey, a short drive from Bear Creek Park and King George Boulevard. Downtown Vancouver is about 40 minutes away by car, and Langley and White Rock are each around 20 minutes. Admissions arranges your arrival date and can help with travel from outside the Lower Mainland.

faqs.question: Who can stay at Bear Creek?

answer_blocks.text: Adult men with alcohol or drug problems. Into Action has been men-only since 2012. It treats alcohol, opioids including fentanyl and heroin, cocaine and crack, benzodiazepines, prescription drugs, cannabis and MDMA, and many residents use more than one substance.

faqs.question: Is Bear Creek licensed in British Columbia?

answer_blocks.text: Yes. BC's Assisted Living Registry lists Into Action - Bear Creek at 13222 87B Avenue as a registered supportive recovery residence, registration SU2016-000006, in the Fraser Health region.

faqs.question: Can I leave the house or have visitors during my stay?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, after an initial restriction period. Staff take residents to community meetings, shopping, walks and hikes from the start. Once restrictions lift you can ask for personal outings and weekend passes, and family contact can begin to the degree you want it.

answer_blocks.text: Men who finish First Stage can move into Into Action's Second Stage sober living for 30 days or longer. It keeps curfew, chores, support meetings and weekly on-site counselling while you go back to work or school. It is optional.

answer_blocks.text: Yes, in designated areas only. That is Into Action's policy across its houses, and recovery.com lists the same rule for Bear Creek.
